text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, that girl...! She kept bumping into 
me over and over during that mock race 
earlier!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You got some nerve picking a fight with 
me...! Bring it on, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Hyowaa~! Her "aura" is insane, though??? 
Is it really okay for me to be this close 
to her divine visage...?!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, that's too soft! If it were 
Windy-chan, I'd bite right into them!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Look! I polish it properly every single 
day, so it's blindingly bright! Hehehe, 
how's that?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Next time I see 'em at the mock 
race, I'm gonna glare 'em down right in 
the face... Just like this!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hey! Digital! What're you 
grinning at over there...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Are you making fun of us!? Huuuh!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!? Holy crap, that glare is totally 
giving me butterflies!! Muhaa~... I can't 
get enough of this...☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What is your deal, bastard!? Why 
are you getting so excited...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, she's even drooling... I really have 
no clue what's going on with her!
